name: Guadalajara
blurb: Conversation about Guadalajara is up 210% on its six-month baseline, driven by travellers describing it as a calmer alternative to nearby hotspots. Most posts mention beaches, value and the shoulder season.

positive: Quieter than the better-known spots nearby
negative: Some report crowding at peak times

quotes.text: Second time here and it still feels underrated.
Much quieter than I expected — barely anyone on the beach at sunset.
Spent a week here working remotely, wifi was fine everywhere.
